lines.en: I walk the valley hunched over.
I work my way down along the cliff.

lines.zh: 我从雾里走过去，雾跟着我。
lines.en: I pass through the mist, and the mist follows.
I twitch as I walk.
I cross a stretch of black grass.
I shift in your direction.
I walk unsteadily, but quickly.
I scraped out of a crack in the cliff.
My claws scrape the stone.
I circle once and come back.
I pause in the mist.
I crouch, shoulders jerking.
My head keeps snapping sideways.
There is a sound in my throat.
Mist rises from my feet.
I am listening to you.
My teeth stay bare.
This valley is very dark.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看着自己的爪子。
lines.en: I raise a hand and look at my claws.
I twitch again.
I have not blinked once.

lines.zh: 我蹲在崖边，喉咙里咕噜响。
lines.en: I crouch at the cliff edge, growling in my throat.

lines.zh: 恐怖山谷里，墙后等你转身。
lines.en: In the horror valley, behind the wall, waiting.
There are no birds in this valley.
I tilt my head and look at you.
I ran my tongue over my teeth.

lines.zh: 恐怖山谷里，只有我一个。
lines.en: In the horror valley, I am the only one.
I shuffled a little closer.
My fingers dig into the soil.
I smile, and it is not much like a smile.
I have caught your scent.
You just stand there and do not move.
I lurch, then straighten.

lines.zh: 我从山谷的雾里走，雾跟着我。
lines.en: I walk out of the valley mist, and it follows.
No one has come here in a long while.

lines.zh: 我歪着脖子，从下往上看你。
lines.en: I crane my neck and look up at you.
You carry the warmth of the living.
My neck jerks again.
I shriek and spring back.
My twitching worsens.
I tilt my head, teeth still bared.
I do not like that.
One step back and I am in the mist.
I clamp a claw over the wound.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓着自己的肩。
lines.en: My claws dig into my own shoulder.
I came back in out of the mist.
I stopped screaming.
I stare at you without moving my eyes.
Food; I am not particular.
I push toward your hand.
Put it in my hand.

lines.zh: 把手递过来，我连手一起咬。
lines.en: Hold out your hand; I bite the hand too.

lines.zh: 恐怖山谷里，我独自一个。
lines.en: In the horror valley, I'm alone.
I may bite your hand with it.
I chewed it down in two bites.
What else is in your hand?
Reach a little lower.
You hit me and I twist.
I give way with the force.
My bones are sharp.
I rake a hand out.
That only brought me closer.
I slide along the ground.
You touched me again.
A knock is nothing to me.
I keep at it with my head tilted.
I am lying across this path.

lines.zh: 这种事，我这副样子做不了。
lines.en: Not in this shape.
This body has no use for it.
I tilt my head.
There is only me in this valley.
I gave no answer at all.
I twitch and turn away.
I lower my head, throat rattling.
I retreat into the mist.
No; that is not up for talk.
I snatch it up.
I bite it and spit.
This is nothing to eat.
I shoved it under me and pressed it.
I hold it and twitch.
I fling it at the rock.
I leaned in and sniffed.
I have put this one away.
I gnaw at it bit by bit.
I went rigid all at once.
I raise my head, all teeth bared.

lines.zh: 恐怖山谷的雾，跟着我走。
lines.en: The horror valley mist follows me.
The mist begins to gather at me.
I have closed around you.
I am not running; I am coming.
The valley's mouth is on the far side.
I spread my claws.
I take this step fast.
I grinned.
It is you I pick.
There is no one else here.
I lean my upper body forward.
I have already started to move.
I follow you hunched over.
You go left, and I lunge left.
I keep to the mist.
My steps fall deep and shallow.
Your scent is on this path.
I drive you toward the cliff edge.
I do not shout; I only pant.
Run on; there is no fork.
I scrape along the rock and follow.
You look back, and I am in the mist.
I pull my shoulders in.
I have no need to speed up.
A few more steps and you are done.

lines.zh: 我听见你的心跳，恐怖山谷很安静。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat; the horror valley is quiet.
The mist has closed around us both.
I break into a run.
My claw opens your arm.

lines.zh: 恐怖山谷的雾，只够我一个人走。
lines.en: The horror valley fog barely fits me.
That was filthy and desperate.
I clamp your shoulder and hold.
I rake, and a nail breaks.
The blow slams you into the cliff.
I twitch and strike again.
That grab missed.
I bite at your leg.
There is blood in my mouth.
I give half a step and lunge again.

lines.zh: 我的指甲断在它的骨头上。
lines.en: My nail snaps on its bone.

lines.zh: 雾里先有声音，然后是我。
lines.en: A sound in the mist first; then me.

lines.zh: 我从崖壁的缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack in the cliff.
The valley has suddenly gone quiet.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，爪子先着地。
lines.en: I land claws first.
I rise, taller than before.
I twitch all over.
My head snaps twice.

lines.zh: 雾里多了一股活人的汗。
lines.en: A living sweat joins the smell of the fog.
I come out of the black grass.
My shadow lies crooked on the ground.
Mist spreads from my feet.
I crouch slowly.
A wind has risen in the valley.
I wait there with my head tilted.
I am only a few steps away.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，骨头硌得响。
lines.en: I hit the stones and my bones clatter.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我在水里乱抓。
lines.en: Water floods my throat and I claw at it.
The blast throws me into the cliff.
Some force locks my limbs.
Hunger makes the twitching worse.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我抓不到东西。
lines.en: There is no ground and nothing to grip.
